fresh_study_english.text: Who lives and reigns for ever and ever.
fresh_study_english.source: New project-created translation of independently witnessed complete public-domain formula with exactly two disclosed grammatical inflections; not a quotation of historical or approved English.

review_judgment: The complete older formula is independently established before any ending is supplied. The target contributes only two verb-person inflections to that same seven-word formula; there is no added word, omitted formula word or new clause. Under the existing narrowly qualified variant route, this is supported as an original study-English ending for this exact hashed candidate. It is not permission to expand per., Per Dominum. or any other cue by memory, nor a claim that the old source prints the third-person forms. The final source records must bind this companion formula and record both changes separately from the ancient petition and its actual per dominum. cue.
admission_boundary: Parent/root retains finite adoption and publication; source/English review supports joint use of this ending proof with the immutable body review. No other target inherits adoption by a shared formula or incipit.
